aggregation: Median of three timed samples per parser, each in a fresh process with one warmup. Run order alternates between pairs.
measurement_scope: Parsing preprocessed in-memory source, including parser rejection paths. File reads and CPP are outside the timed region. The benchmark forces ParseResult values using its existing implementation.
machine_activity: MacBook in normal use, with concurrent compiler workloads.
